comment: Proposed default mapping (QWB-50; relation field renamed QWB-54 ticket 12): the fields the crm/contacts cube actually has. name is joined from firstname + lastname (salutation and title are dropped unless the owner says otherwise). organizationId comes from vtiger's own foreign key contactdetails.accountid, resolved by an externalId lookup into qwbe (QWB-54, ticket 13); an organization that is not in qwbe is counted, never invented. cube/table name the database home of the unique externalId index.
dropped: contact_no (human-facing number, the contact cube has no field for it yet)
mobile (one phone field in the cube; owner may swap phone -> mobile after the profile)
reportsto (contact-to-contact hierarchy is out of scope)
mailing* address block (the contact cube has no address fields)
all cf_* columns (decided from the staging profile, owner signs off)
